# test/fixtures/stories/

Real stories the running app produced, kept as regression cases.

- `first-real-story-volcanoes.json` — the owner's first saved story (2026-09-29, band A,
  Sonnet 5, master.v1). The gate sent its first draft back, the rewrite failed review too,
  and it was saved `flagged`. It is the evidence the band rubric was designed from: 10.4% of
  its sentences run over 20 words (the band-A references: 2.7% and 3.4%), and its True Facts
  list names the "Mid-Atlantic Ridge", which the story never used.
